title: Open-cluster recovery and candidate search in Gaia DR3

hypotheses.statement: Density-based clustering in a declared feature space recovers known open clusters in the predeclared regions at a rate comparable to published catalogues.
evaluation_criteria: recovery rate against hr23 and cga20 with bootstrap intervals

hypotheses.statement: Candidates surviving null-field, injection, stability and CMD checks and absent from both benchmarks are potentially new clusters.
evaluation_criteria: false-positive rate under null fields below tolerance

hypotheses.statement: The SDP pipeline matches or exceeds the published Hunt and Reffert HDBSCAN configuration on recovery at equal contamination.
evaluation_criteria: paired comparison against the registered hr23 baseline

gates.description: Predeclared target regions and quality cuts recorded and frozen before the first Gaia query
Benchmark catalogues registered with release labels, licences and citations
Known-cluster recovery reported with intervals against both benchmarks
Null-field false-positive rate below the predeclared tolerance
Injection recovery curve reported across richness and distance
Every candidate labelled potentially new has a cross-match record against both benchmarks
Rejected and inconclusive candidates retained with failure reasons
GPU adapter agreement with the CPU reference, or GPU results excluded from the gates
Report distinguishes candidate from confirmed discovery in a fixed sentence pattern

targets.reason: Rich, nearby benchmark cluster: a recovery sanity check that every method must pass
Second nearby benchmark with a different proper-motion signature
Crowded Galactic-plane field with distant double cluster: tests contamination and distance completeness
High-latitude control field near the North Galactic Pole where few clusters are expected: an empirical null

notes: DRAFT for Phase 0 review. Regions, cuts, candidate_checks (the pass marks: members, stability across the grid, CMD coherence, share of the field) and the null-field tolerance are proposals; Leigh confirms them before freeze().
